Part 1 : Connecting with students. Part 2 : Connecting with parents.

This two-volume set applies William Glasser's theory of connectedness to enhancing students achievement and winning parental support. The first volume details classroom strategies for both elementary and secondary levels, revealing how a caring, trusting relationship with students positively affects learning. The second illustrates steps thay enable teachers to secure ongoing support from parents.
